AUDIT QUESTION: Hostile audit, CYCLE 1, of pp-selectid REQUESTS R7 item 1 applied to pipeline/pinned.py (Protocol Pulse video pipeline). Context: law L-q (moments first, then package) makes a moments-first package the editorial decision; tonight it is rendered through the existing PINNED entry point: the package (written by pp-selectid's package_pin.write_pin) is a PIN.json whose segments carry approved_text (the moments' exact words, located by text in the acquired transcript under the sentence law) plus a top-level 'moments_package' {title, caption, package_sha256, checks {vo_fidelity_ok, context_integrity_ok, ...}, edl_vo {intro, bridges [{text, after_clip}]}}. build_edl takes the VO from the package (intro + one bridge after each clip but the last, the renderer's placement), carries the ONE title and caption (law L-t), the package sha256 and the gate verdicts into the EDL, and refuses (PinError) a bridge the renderer cannot place or a package whose VO-fidelity and context-integrity gates did not BOTH pass; a pin without a package is unchanged (no body VO, Editorial Law 2's default). Downstream every stage is shared and unchanged (validate: edl_rules / editorial gate Law 2 / stand-alone / layout; cut; sentence law; voice; prepare; layout; render 16:9 + 9:16; gates; verify; release authorisation). FIND, with file and line, only what you can verify from the diff ('uncertain' otherwise): (1) any package shape that passes moments_vo but the renderer cannot place or would place differently than intended (indices, after_clip types: bool/float/str, duplicates, order, a bridge after the hook); (2) any way a package whose gates did not both pass, or a package with missing/forged checks, reaches the EDL; (3) missing keys raising something other than PinError (title, caption, package_sha256, edl_vo shape, checks not a dict); (4) whether the EDL's new fields can change what any existing gate accepts for a pin WITHOUT a package (must not); (5) whether the title/caption are actually bound anywhere a downstream stage reads them (law L-t requires them in the release authorisation; say whether this diff does that or leaves it to later); (6) test weaknesses. No praise.

+def moments_vo(mp, clips):
+    """The package's VO, checked by its VO-fidelity and context-integrity gates (pipeline/package.py): the intro and
+    one bridge after each clip but the last, in the EDL's shape ({"text", "after_clip"}). Fail closed on any shape
+    the renderer cannot place (a bridge after the hook, after the last clip, or after a missing clip)."""
+    v = mp.get("edl_vo") or {}
+    intro = v.get("intro")
+    bridges = v.get("bridges") or []
+    idx = {c["index"] for c in clips}
+    for b in bridges:
+        if not isinstance(b, dict) or not str(b.get("text") or "").strip() or b.get("after_clip") not in idx or                 b["after_clip"] == max(idx):
+            raise PinError(f"moments_package bridge {b!r}: needs text and after_clip in 1..{max(idx) - 1}")
+    if intro is not None and not str(intro).strip():
+        raise PinError("moments_package intro is empty")
+    if not mp.get("checks", {}).get("vo_fidelity_ok") or not mp.get("checks", {}).get("context_integrity_ok"):
+        raise PinError("moments_package: the VO-fidelity and context-integrity gates did not both pass")
+    return {"intro": intro, "bridges": [{"text": b["text"], "after_clip": b["after_clip"]} for b in bridges]}
+
+
 def prepare(pin_path, run_dir, log=print):
     """Validate + acquire + build. Writes edl.json, vertical_overrides.json, PINNED_DECISION.json.
     Returns the PINNED_DECISION record. Raises PinError."""

+        self.assertEqual(edl["moments_checks"], {"vo_fidelity_ok": True, "context_integrity_ok": True})
